description.value:
While your companion is within 5 feet of you, you can spend a bonus action to begin a coordinated maneuver. For the next minute, as long as you and your companion remain within 5 feet of each other and neither wields a shield, you each gain a bonus to AC equal to half your proficiency bonus.

This effect ends early if either of you is incapacitated or dies. Once used, it requires a long rest before you can use it again.
